summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a few frontier families—OpenAI's GPT, Anthropic's Claude, and Google's Gemini—while open-weight models from Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba's Qwen drive enormous HuggingFace adoption. Enterprise consumption increasingly flows through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which meaningfully amplifies real-world usage beyond direct-API numbers. Because much of the live research data references unconfirmed or speculative version numbers, this ranking is restricted to models whose names can be verified against official docs and the provided sources.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently the most-called general-purpose model across developer surveys and API volume, and available through Azure OpenAI for massive enterprise reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal input and reliability

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Confirmed released February 17, 2026 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; heavily adopted for coding and available via AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Coding assistants and enterprise agentic workflows

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Known as the context-window leader among frontier models and natively distributed through Google Vertex AI, giving it strong enterprise penetration.
models.best_for: Long-document and large-context analysis in Google Cloud environments

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B MoE reasoning model (37B active) cited as the cheapest frontier-class model at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens, driving heavy HuggingFace downloads and self-hosting.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The high-throughput, low-cost Gemini tier widely used for high-volume applications and available through Google Vertex AI aggregator reach.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Open-weight flagship with strong general performance at a fraction of proprietary costs, generating large HuggingFace download volumes.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and broadly available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI for enterprise deployment.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: The fast, low-cost Claude tier popular for high-volume agentic and classification tasks, distributed via AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
models.best_for: High-volume, low-latency production and agentic tasks

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A leading open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace adoption, especially strong in multilingual and Asian-market deployments.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Europe's leading frontier-class model with solid enterprise adoption and availability through AWS Bedrock and Azure, favored for data-sovereignty use cases.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments with data-sovereignty requirements
